header.name: PatrixWorld Sampler [DENSE+VARS v0.2.4]
header.description: v0.2.4 DENSE+VARS — user-reported regressions fixed. (1) RESTORED 16-variant block variation for 23 surface blocks (stone, andesite, granite, diorite, dirt, coarse_dirt, sand, red_sand, gravel, grass_block_top + grass_top alias, mycelium_top/side, cobblestone, deepslate, end_stone, netherrack, mud, packed_mud, mud_bricks, muddy_mangrove_roots_top/side, sandstone_top, red_sandstone_top). v0.2.2 research said variations don't work on vanilla Bedrock (MCPE-165946) but user observation contradicted research — variants were visibly rendering in v0.2.1. Trusting the user's eyes. 368 variant PNGs restored from v0.2.1 cache, 16 per block with weight 10. (2) LEAF DILATION — v0.2.3 shipped raw Patrix leaves at 23-41% opacity causing sparse/see-through canopies (perceived as 'ruined canopy dimensions and foliage density'). Applied dilate_alpha_fill_rgb to 8 leaf species to reach 47-56% target opacity — denser silhouettes without forming solid green blocks. For over-target species (birch/jungle/mangrove), used probabilistic dilation targeting exactly 50%. Carries all v0.2.3 BARKFIX fixes (blocks.json format_version 1.1.0, grass_block_side alias, podzol, Patrix log/plank ports for all 10 species, 70+ new block ports, lava flipbook).
